shorts.vo: Rockstar just broke car physics. Look at this cop car. The hood folds, the bumper rips off, and the glass shatters into real pieces, not a texture swap. Now watch the tires. Shoot them and they actually deflate, so the car starts sliding. And those red and blue sirens? They bounce off every shop window in real time. This is a four star chase with this much traffic, and the game doesn't even drop a frame. GTA Five never looked like this. Would you survive this chase? Tell me in the comments.

shorts.hook: Count the people on this rooftop.
shorts.vo: Count the people on this rooftop. Every single one is doing something different. Drinking, talking, leaning on the railing. None of them are copies. Now look past them. That's the whole Vice City skyline, cruise ships in the bay, planes in the sky, and it's all loaded at once. No fog hiding the distance. And look at the skin. You can see pores and tan lines in sunlight. This is a cutscene level of detail, but it's gameplay. Follow for more GTA Six details you missed.

GTA Six water is unreal. Watch the airboat cut through the swamp. The wake splashes and the plants move with it. Now we go underwater. See the light patterns on the cave floor? Those are real caustics, and the water gets darker the deeper you dive. Then kayaking downtown. Every paddle stroke makes its own ripples. Old GTA water was a flat blue plane. This is a simulation. Would you rather explore the swamp or the city? Comment below.

These are not real people. This is GTA Six. Look at this guy's shirt. Every wrinkle moves when he breathes. Now look at Jason. Sweat on the skin, veins in the arms, tattoos that bend with the muscle. And when we hit the highway, every sign is readable and the skyline goes on forever. The beach is full of people, and none of them look copy pasted. Rockstar spent ten years on this, and it shows. Which character do you want to play as? Comment below.

The lighting in GTA Six is insane. Look at this red light on the mask. It bleeds onto the gun, the hands, the wall behind him. Now this sunset. The sun actually scatters through the clouds and lights up the water. Inside the bar, every lamp casts its own shadow on every single person. And at night, the club glows purple on the crowd. This is real time lighting, not a movie. Rockstar is playing a different game. Day or night, which looks better? Tell me.

Vice City is alive again. Neon clubs that glow all night. Ammu-Nation is back, and look how many guns are on that wall. Then you go home, crash on the couch, and someone walks in on you. Grab a bike, ride down the coast with the sun in your face. This is not a city you visit. It's a city you live in. One week left, guys. Follow so you don't miss the next one.

This is the GTA Six map, and it's massive. Welcome to Leonida. Vice City is the heart, with beaches packed with people, and an ocean you can actually explore. Drive out of town and you hit the Everglades. Swamps, wildlife, and sunsets like this. At night, the whole city lights up. It's the biggest world Rockstar has ever built. Where would you go first? Comment below.

Vice City after dark hits different. Neon on every street, the clubs are packed, and everyone's living their best life. Then the sun comes up, and the party moves to the water. Boat parties, rooftop pools, and beaches with hundreds of people at once. This city never sleeps. Day or night, where are you going? Tell me.

GTA Six is basically Florida, and the people are wild. This guy tattooed his entire face. This one has more gold in his mouth than in his bank account. Dirt bike gangs take over the streets, and this dude is dancing in traffic. Rockstar took a lot of this from real Florida viral videos. Which one would you trust? Comment below.
